title: Moniah breaks free with electrifying new track “RUN”
htmlContent: After making waves with her song HARSH REALITY, which has gained almost 10,000 streams on Spotify, Moniah is back with a new track called RUN. This energetic anthem is all about overcoming fears and embracing freedom. It's a powerful reminder to break free from limitations and seize the life waiting for us when we push past our doubts. RUN is bold and exciting, combining strong beats with uplifting melodies that perfectly capture the feeling of breaking free. Moniah's vocals are striking and sometimes soaring but always captivating. You can feel the passion in her voice, making every line feel like a personal call to action. RUN combines deep emotions with a sound that's perfect for radio. The lyrics resonate with anyone who has ever felt stuck or afraid. https://open.spotify.com/track/1LxA6cWrIOSHnj6nFFFZiI Moniah uses her experiences to motivate listeners to take the leap and go for what they want. Following the success of HARSH REALITY, RUN establishes Moniah as an artist who's showing that her music is something you can feel. With a growing fan base across the UK, Europe, and North America, Moniah is on a path to greatness. With RUN, she invites everyone to join her on this journey. Follow on: Instagram/TikTok
